title: UG-003 — How to add quiz questions
intent: Explain how quiz-compatible questions are added to a quiz survey.
short_answer: In the editor toolbox, quiz-compatible question types are marked with a special icon. Add them by double-clicking the item or using drag and drop. After adding a quiz question, configure its Quiz Properties in the properties pane.
important_conditions: Other question types can be used in the quiz questionnaire, but they cannot be used to calculate a score.
